title: Former Chicago Bears kicker Robbie Gould to resign as head football coach of Saint Viator High School in Arlington Heights
text:
Former Chicago Bears kicker Robbie Gould to resign as head football coach of Saint Viator High School in Arlington Heights - ABC7 Chicago

 Former Chicago Bears kicker Robbie Gould to resign as Saint Viator High School head football coach 
 Thursday, October 22, 2026 3:45AM 
 Former Chicago Bears kicker Robbie Gould plans to resign as the head football coach of Saint Viator High School in Arlington Heights, the school said. ARLINGTON HEIGHTS, Ill. (WLS) -- Former Chicago Bears kicker Robbie Gould plans to resign as the head football coach of a local high school.
 Saint Viator High School in Arlington Heights made the announcement Wednesday.
 ABC7 Chicago is now streaming 24/7. Click here to watch 
 Gould will step down as the head football coach after the conclusion of the 2026 season, the school said.
 The 18-year NFL veteran made the decision to spend more time with his family, according to the school's statement.
 "We are grateful to Coach Gould for his leadership, dedication, and commitment to our student-athletes," Ryan Aiello, president of Saint Viator High School, said in a statement. "We appreciate his contributions to Saint Viator football, respect his decision to prioritize his family and wish him all the best."

 Chicago Bears' Robbie Gould kicks a field goal during an NFL football game against the Dallas Cowboys Monday, Oct. 1, 2012, in Arlington, Texas. (AP Photo/LM Otero) 
 Gould spent 10 years with the Bears, where he's widely considered the best kicker in franchise history. He finished his career with the San Francisco 49ers.
 In 2024, he coached at Rolling Meadows High School .
